The MB O 303 was one of the most successful coaches. It was the successor of the O 302 and adopted much of its technology. The first years of construction were only delivered with a split windscreen. The chrome-plated goggles around the headlights and radiator grille were also typical, but were removed from 1982 after the facelift.
